children: Rank One Computing's revenue rose 50% and earnings moved to net income from a loss year over year, as higher R&D contract revenue—primarily from increased activity on a U.S. Government research contract—and higher product revenue led by ROC ABIS more than offset lower ROC Watch revenue. Higher gross profit and lower tax expense more than offset higher operating expenses.
¹ Reported as “Sales”. ² Reported as “Net (loss) income”. ³ Reported as “Earnings (loss) per share — diluted”.
: Rose 24%, led by ROC ABIS, up $1.9M, and ROC SDK, up $0.9M; lower ROC Watch revenue partially offset gains.
: Revenue increased 175%, primarily due to increased activity on a U.S. Government research contract that began in 2Q 2026.
: Increased to 90% from 79%, reflecting a mix weighted toward software licenses, including a significant ROC ABIS platform license.
: A one-year base period for ROC Evidence development and support has potential fees of up to $7.4M; seven one-year options could bring the eight-year total to $64.3M.
